title: 80th INDEPENDENCE DAY FLAG HOISTING CEREMONY
text:
★

80th Independence Day of Pakistan

Flag Hoisting Ceremony

Notification regarding the Flag Hoisting Ceremony
to be held on the occasion of the

80th Independence Day of Pakistan

★

It is hereby notified for information of all concerned that,
on the occasion of the
80th Independence Day of Pakistan
,
a Flag Hoisting Ceremony will be held at

Garden Campus, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
,
in the presence of

Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad, Vice Chancellor, AWKUM
.

📅

Date

Friday, August 14, 2026

⏰

Ceremony

9:00 AM

📍

Venue

Garden Campus, AWKUM

Ceremony Programme

Time | Programme
8:45 AM | Arrival of Participants
9:00 AM | Tilawat-e-Quran Pak
9:05 AM | Flag Hoisting of the National Flag
9:10 AM | National Anthem
9:15 AM | Message by Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad,
Vice Chancellor, AWKUM
9:25 AM | Prayer/Dua for Peace, Solidarity and Prosperity
of the Country
9:40 AM | Cake Cutting and Refreshment

In the Presence of the Vice Chancellor

The ceremony will be held in the presence of

Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad, Vice Chancellor,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
.

Important Instructions for Heads

All Deans of the Faculties, Heads of Teaching Departments
and Heads of Sections are requested to ensure their presence
at the ceremony and also to inform employees under their
respective administrative control accordingly.

🇵🇰 Pakistan Zindabad 🇵🇰

Unity • Faith • Discipline
